paragraph_reviews.text: The queue test compared the existing worker with the proposed worker on 12 jobs. Ten jobs completed in both configurations. For those ten jobs, median processing time fell from 75 ms to 52 ms with the proposed worker. Two other jobs failed before producing a timing result and were excluded from that comparison. We have not established what caused those failures.
